blind.description: A collection of stylized earthenware and glazed ceramic vessels arranged closely on a square woven mat. The pottery includes a tall reddish terracotta amphora with two loop handles, two large round brown clay storage jars, a dark green glazed pitcher, two tan cylindrical cups/tumblers, three small round lidded jars (in maroon, brown, and dark green), and several tiny cups lined along the front edge. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and slightly glossy with a stylized, handcrafted clay appearance.
blind.from_above: A square textured mat packed tightly with circular openings, lids, and vessel tops in varied shades of terracotta red, brown, beige, and dark green, surrounded by smooth grey ground.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: a square woven wicker or fabric mat
blind.height_vs_figure: The tallest amphora reaches about one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 ft tall), and the square mat spans roughly 2.5 ft on each side.
